processed_items.location: Mayfair, London, UK & DIFC, Dubai, UAE
processed_items.description: DarGlobal PLC is an international luxury real estate developer listed on the London Stock Exchange. The company specializes in developing second homes and luxury holiday residences in prime international locations across the United Kingdom, Spain, Oman, Qatar, Maldives, and Saudi Arabia. DarGlobal is distinguished by its exclusive collaborations with prestigious global luxury brands including Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, Pagani Automobili, Elie Saab, Missoni, Fendi Casa, Mouawad, The Trump Organization, and Marriott International.
amenities: High Capital Appreciation & Rental Yield Potential
